events.name: CONFORMITY_UPDATED
events.description: The conformity state after each learner action — a composed listener (readout, grader) can subscribe; a harmless no-op when the atom runs standalone.
events.synonyms: conformity update, step, local majority, deviance rate, convergence

events.name: MODE_SELECTED
events.description: Lab router broadcast naming the active mode; this instrument renders when the mode equals matchMode, otherwise renders null.

events.name: STEP
events.description: Learner pressed Step to advance the conformity simulation by one round of local-majority adoption.

events.name: RESET
events.description: Learner pressed Reset to restore the initial population (a lone deviant in a conforming majority).

overridableConfigKeys.label: Agent Count
overridableConfigKeys.description: Number of agents in the population. At seeding, all hold opinion 0 except one lone deviant in the middle.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: agents, population, actors, conformity, social influence

overridableConfigKeys.label: Deviance Rate
overridableConfigKeys.description: Probability (0-0.5) that an agent deliberately adopts the opposite of its local majority in a step — Merton's nonconformist. Zero drives fast convergence; high values fragment the population.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: deviance, nonconformity, Merton, innovation, rebellion, social deviance

overridableConfigKeys.label: Deviant Color
overridableConfigKeys.description: Color of agents holding opinion 1 (the initial deviance).

overridableConfigKeys.label: Grid Columns
overridableConfigKeys.description: How many agents per row when the population is laid out on the canvas grid.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Grid Margin
overridableConfigKeys.description: Margin in pixels between the grid of agents and the canvas edge.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Interactive
overridableConfigKeys.description: Enable pointer interaction on the canvas.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Match Mode
overridableConfigKeys.description: When composed behind a lab router, the MODE_SELECTED mode value this instrument responds to. Empty string means standalone — render immediately on INIT.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Neighborhood Size
overridableConfigKeys.description: How many agents on each side (in row order) count as an agent's neighborhood when computing the local majority it conforms to.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: neighborhood, reference group, peer influence, local majority

overridableConfigKeys.label: Norm Color
overridableConfigKeys.description: Color of agents holding opinion 0 (the initial norm).
